explanation: Two free-falling circles collide at step 4 (touching pair gap ~0.0075) with no controller work. Energy jumps from ~6251.5 J at step 3 to ~7273.2 J at step 4, exceeding E0*1.1+5. Changing restitution to 0 leaves the trace identical, and separating the bodies removes the violation, so the body-body impulse plus positional correction injects kinetic energy instead of conserving/dissipating it.
